newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast raises unit's share capital.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast raises unit's share capital.

text.p: Hungarian home improvement product maker Graboplast Rt said on Thursday that it raised the issued share capital in its textile unit Uniontext Kft.
Uniontext's capital was increased by 233 million forints to 1.05 billion forints on January 15, it said in a statement.
Following the capital hike Graboplast remained a 100 percent owner of Uniontext.

Earlier this week Graboplast raised its stake in its carpet subsidiary Sotex Rt to 71.8 percent via a capital increase that brought Sotex's capital to 1.08 billion forints up by 162 million via a private share issue.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Graboplast was quoted at a new record high of 6,500 forints, up 450.
